content_text:
Company Description
Egis is a leading global organisation in architecture, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services. We partner with clients to design, deliver and operate smarter infrastructure and places that respond to the world’s evolving needs.
With more than 22,000 employees worldwide, we combine global capability with strong local insight. Our multidisciplinary expertise enables us to deliver innovative, practical and sustainable solutions that help build more balanced, resilient communities.
At Egis, you’ll be part of a business shaping the future of cities, transport, energy and the built environment, creating lasting impact where it matters most.
Job Description
Step into a role where your ideas and curiosity genuinely matter. As a Graduate Consultant, you’ll contribute to real projects from your first week.
You’ll support rail and rolling stock projects across Australia for a range of clients, as well as contribute to developing our business through tenders and other engagements. Join our dynamic and high-performing Rail team for the 2027 Graduate intake!
What we offer you
- 
Peer Mentorship: with a dedicated buddy system gain guidance and support from emerging young professionals within your industry.
- 
Continuous Learning: collaborate, problem solve and thrive in a supportive environment.
- 
Hands-on Industry Experience: work in an area where many specialties intersect and problem solve to create unique solutions.
- 
Collaboration: as your career develops, work closely with experts across civil, mechanical, mechatronic and electrical engineering.
Key responsibilities
- 
Client Focus: Develop ongoing relationships with industry clients and engage with stakeholders. Build your communication and presentation skills through client interactions, with opportunities to represent Egis in client-facing environments and contribute to a diverse range of rail projects.
- 
Teamwork: You’ll work alongside a variety of specialists, learning how different disciplines come together to deliver successful projects. Collaborate with teams across Australia to support tender submissions and build industry networks.
- 
Problem Solving: Tackle real challenges, think creatively and help shape practical solutions that improve project outcomes.
- 
Quality Focus: Learn how we meet industry standards and regulations while delivering work we’re proud of.
Qualifications
What do we need from you
- Graduating prior to commencing full-time work in February 2027
- Tertiary degree in Civil, Mechanical or Mechatronic Engineering
- Available to start February 2027
- Relevant work rights to live and work full-time in Australia. This position is not open to applicants outside of Australia
About you
- Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to present confidently and engage with a range of stakeholders
- Motivated self-starter with a strong desire to learn and grow
- Genuine interest in rail infrastructure and consulting projects
- Relevant internship, vacation, or industry experience is highly valued
Additional Information
Egis is committed to creating an inclusive, creative culture that embraces diversity and flexibility. We offer generous parental leave, support flexible work practices and strive to create an environment where employees can connect, collaborate, grow and succeed.
We are expanding in Australia and New Zealand and are excited for you to join our growing team!
TO APPLY 
Please attach your resume, cover letter and academic transcripts as a single document.
We believe our strong graduate program will provide you with the tools you need to start your career the right way.
If this sounds like the opportunity for you APPLY NOW!
